meta.title: PO Consumption Tracking: refused for a user without the Buyer / Finance role
gaps: Sign in as a user without Buyer/Finance, locate PO Consumption Tracking, and verify that consumed versus remaining PO quantity and value is refused or unavailable.
Sign in as a Buyer/Finance user in the same tenant, locate PO Consumption Tracking, and verify that consumed versus remaining PO quantity and value is available.
Verify or report tenant RBAC configuration when the tenant intentionally grants PO Consumption Tracking to additional roles.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without Buyer/Finance, locate PO Consumption Tracking, and verify that consumed versus remaining PO quantity and value is refused or unavailable.; Sign in as a Buyer/Finance user in the same tenant, locate PO Consumption Tracking, and verify that consumed versus remaining PO quantity and value is available.; Verify or report tenant RBAC configuration when the tenant intentionally grants PO Consumption Tracking to additional roles.

args.need: sign in as both the non-Buyer/Finance user and the Buyer/Finance user in the same tenant, attempt PO Consumption Tracking for each, and report whether consumed versus remaining PO quantity and value is refused, absent, or available

steps.note: The catalog cannot switch to these role-specific users, navigate PO Consumption Tracking, or assert its permission behavior.
Provides the required final assertion that the resulting screen has no crash or server error, but does not cover the missing role-access subject.
